question: Rohan is facing west. He turns 45 degrees anti-clockwise and then turns 180 degrees towards his right. In which direction is he facing now?
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

1) Rohan is facing west and then he turns 45 degrees anti-clockwise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7296625470b1716a1bc73b0f83702013d3ca0ffd0752716d146915d94bd33e9f.png] 

2) Then Rohan turns 180 degrees towards his right.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/882f49a28d95b009695157147ded06c5ef3755e53a6f926c0e2fc93a529b96f5.png] 

∴ Here, Rohan is facing towards "North-East".

Hence, the correct answer is **"North-East".**
